verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken layout. The small doodles (arrow, bulb, question mark, atom) are crammed in a row across the man's face and mouth. The 'PODCAST WITH HARRY LEE HOFFMAN' subtitle sits far off in the top-right corner, cut off from the headline it belongs to. The molecule drawing is oversized and competes with the headline for attention. In A, 'HOW IT WORKS?' butts right up against the cheek and smile. B moves the headline slightly right, so it clears the face a bit better, but its doodles still collide with the face.
